peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 22.2% below its local comparables; 14 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (92.6): 6.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 363 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 2). Initial resale-wave effect: 9 of the 14 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Dec 2024–Nov 2025), so this figure is not yet a sustained rate; sustained activity remains settling. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 41.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave

lines.statement: Settling: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave, so sustained activity is not yet measurable. Observed activity is shown. First resale wave from Dec 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 2 earlier resales do not start the wave. 10 months available from Dec 2025; measurable with data to Nov 2026. Observed: 6.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months).

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Aljunied MRT about 530 m, Mountbatten MRT about 550 m; closer than 287 of 662 similar developments (the same as 9). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Kong Hwa School about 530 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 260 m), more than 362 of 662 similar developments (the same as 63); nearest hawker centre Old Airport Road Food Centre And Shopping Mall about 440 m; nearest park Wilkinson Interim Park about 1,090 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Old Airport Road Food Centre And Shopping Mall

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 270 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 910 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,290 m; Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 1,320 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 1,620 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,780 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,840 m; Meyer Blue, 20 new sales, about 1,920 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 275 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 413 new sales and 569 resales (982 purchases); new sales were 42.1% of these purchases. Subsales (67) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Tanjong Rhu Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,640 m; Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,730 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 569 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 144 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 569 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 689 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−17.4%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
